developerNotes.title: Developer Script-Event Authorization Is Not Centralized
developerNotes.problem: Reset, database, and developer script events do not consistently pass through one explicit developer authorization owner.
developerNotes.action: Route all developer and admin mutations through one canonical permission service.

developerNotes.title: Internal Role Terminology Is Mixed
developerNotes.problem: Game-facing terminology is Corrupted Bearer, while internal state and result identifiers still use Hunter terminology. No current gameplay failure is claimed.
developerNotes.action: Normalize the internal domain vocabulary to Corrupted Bearer or Bearer where the concept is game-specific.
